3	  {"id": "p3-001", "text": "At month three, put each person's name and a dated outcome 30+ months out on a public commitment board, and staff the work so no substitute exists mid-flight."},
4	  {"id": "p3-002", "text": "Assign each senior person three-year named warranty over a live system, and publish its uptime and incident record under their name as a portable, tenure-gated credential."},
5	  {"id": "p3-003", "text": "Pay a deferred share of the measured profit or cost-saving of the specific thing each person built, settled at 36 months from ship date, forfeited on early exit."},
6	  {"id": "p3-004", "text": "Give each person a named external constituency they personally hold while employed: a standards-body seat, a regulator relationship, or three named customer accounts that route to them directly."},
7	  {"id": "p3-005", "text": "Build one proprietary instrument, dataset or test rig that exists nowhere else, and give every technical hire unlimited unsupervised access to it."},
8	  {"id": "p3-006", "text": "Deliberately let one person become the only living expert on a commercially load-bearing subject, and say so publicly and by name in writing to customers."},
9	  {"id": "p3-007", "text": "Let anyone past 18 months propose a new unit, and if accepted give them the headcount requisitions, budget line and hiring authority to staff it themselves."},
10	  {"id": "p3-008", "text": "Acquire an employee's existing side project into the company as a subsidiary they continue to run, with a minority stake retained by them."},
11	  {"id": "p3-009", "text": "Re-price every salary quarterly against live market data by published formula, applied automatically without anyone asking or negotiating."},
12	  {"id": "p3-010", "text": "Compress ramp to 90 days with a paid full-time overlap shadow and a pre-built environment, so the hardest work starts in month four rather than month thirteen."},
13	  {"id": "p3-011", "text": "Keep a sealed queue of the firm's three hardest unsolved problems and release one only to a person past month ten, one at a time."},
14	  {"id": "p3-012", "text": "Offer each person the right to buy real money into their own project at a fixed valuation, with a defined buy-back at the outcome date."},
15	  {"id": "p3-013", "text": "Commit in writing to spinning out any unit that reaches defined revenue, with its lead becoming founder and cap-table holder of the spinout."},
16	  {"id": "p3-014", "text": "Every nine months, make each person a fresh written competing bid for their next eighteen months: named problem, scope, money, dated, delivered before recruiters get there."},
17	  {"id": "p3-015", "text": "Pay a royalty to the builder whenever internal tooling they wrote is licensed, sold or used by a customer, continuing while they remain."},
18	  {"id": "p3-016", "text": "Run a board-certification-style residency: a 24-month sequence with logged cases and an external examination, awarded only on completion, the way medical fellowships work."},
19	  {"id": "p3-017", "text": "Structure work as rolling 24-month commitments that begin every eight months, so a person is always mid-way through two of them at once."},
20	  {"id": "p3-018", "text": "Provide a housing loan or rent subsidy near the workplace that forgives over four years, settled at exit."},
21	  {"id": "p3-019", "text": "Convert people at 18 months onto a partner-style arrangement: a percentage of fees on work they originate, paid for as long as the client stays."},
22	  {"id": "p3-020", "text": "Bid for one project whose blast radius exceeds anything a large firm would ever hand a single mid-career person, and hand it to a single mid-career person."},
23	  {"id": "p3-021", "text": "Pay a quarterly bonus for forwarding unsolicited recruiter mail into a shared channel where the firm posts, publicly, what it would and would not match."},
24	  {"id": "p3-022", "text": "Give each person past twelve months a discretionary capital budget they spend unilaterally with no approval, scaling with tenure, reported after the fact."},
25	  {"id": "p3-023", "text": "Grant employees named ownership of IP they author, vesting to them over four years, licensed back to the firm perpetually and royalty-free."},
26	  {"id": "p3-024", "text": "Host and fund a small invite-only external research circle, and give each senior employee a seat in it that reverts to the firm when they leave."},
27	  {"id": "p3-025", "text": "Publish per-person friction metrics — approvals required, idea-to-production days, people who can veto you — so any large-employer offer can be compared numerically against them."},
28	  {"id": "p3-026", "text": "Offer a guaranteed seat back within twelve months, in writing, to anyone who takes a job at a larger employer, with tenure and deferred payouts continuing."},
29	  {"id": "p3-027", "text": "Write a scope covenant into the contract: defined expansion of authority at fixed dates, or a liquidated cash payment to the employee if missed."},
30	  {"id": "p3-028", "text": "Recruit intact pairs and trios who have worked together before, staff them as a unit, and let them accept or reject work as a unit."},
31	  {"id": "p3-029", "text": "Choose a line of business that large employers are structurally conflicted out of — competing with their clients, or under a licence they cannot hold — and make it the core work."},
32	  {"id": "p3-030", "text": "Cap headcount publicly at a fixed number, never exceed it, and fill any opening by internal claim before external hiring."},
33	  {"id": "p3-031", "text": "Recruit people whose constraint large employers cannot serve — fixed caregiving hours, remote geography, medical schedule — and design the role and delivery model around that constraint."}
34	 ]}

4	  {"id": "p6-002", "text": "Run a cohort pot: fix a large sum per hiring class, divide it only among members still present at year four, and publish the rising per-head figure mon

1	{"lens": "Analogical transfer", "pool": 6,
2	 "items": [
3	  {"id": "p6-001", "text": "Pay a percentage of each shipped product's realized revenue for three years after it ships rather than a salary premium, settled quarterly, the way commercial fishing crews take a lay share of the catch after the voyage lands."},
4	  {"id": "p6-002", "text": "Run a cohort pot: fix a large sum per hiring class, divide it only among members still present at year four, and publish the rising per-head figure monthly, as in a tontine."},
5	  {"id": "p6-003", "text": "Contract in bonded groups of four with a single joint fee split by the group, so any one departure cuts the other three's pay, as string quartets and chamber ensembles sign as an ensemble."},
6	  {"id": "p6-004", "text": "Keep every person holding two firm-dated project commitments eighteen and thirty months out, signed pay-or-play with named start dates, the way film crews are booked forward across pictures."},
7	  {"id": "p6-005", "text": "Give each person a land-trust-style split: they own their improvements outright and sell them back at a formula price on exit, while the firm holds the underlying platform, as in community land trusts."},
8	  {"id": "p6-006", "text": "Re-strike every package automatically each quarter against a published external index of market rates with no negotiation and no manager discretion, the way offshore drilling contracts index day-rates."},
9	  {"id": "p6-007", "text": "Make people members with share capital and an annual patronage dividend proportional to their contribution, redeemable at book value only, the way credit unions treat departing members."},
10	  {"id": "p6-008", "text": "Permanently attach the person's name to the systems they originate in a public registry the firm maintains and keeps updating for decades, the way first-ascent registries credit climbing routes."},
11	  {"id": "p6-009", "text": "Disclose the proprietary internals in staged degrees at fixed tenure thresholds, with each stage genuinely unavailable earlier and useless out of context, as Masonic degrees release knowledge on a fixed progression."},
12	  {"id": "p6-010", "text": "Put each person's flagship project into a dated maturation programme with a public bottling date years out, where only the named creator may release it, as whisky casks name their distiller."},
13	  {"id": "p6-011", "text": "Fund the person to found a majority-independent subsidiary you part-own at the moment their value peaks, deliberately splitting the group, the way beekeepers make an artificial swarm before a colony absconds."},
14	  {"id": "p6-012", "text": "Loan people formally to rival institutions for fixed terms with signed return dates and shared output rights, the way zoos exchange animals under studbook breeding loans."},
15	  {"id": "p6-013", "text": "Hire on voyage articles: fixed multi-year terms tied to a named mission, with the accumulated wage paid as a lump at term's end, as merchant seamen sign ship's articles per voyage."},
16	  {"id": "p6-014", "text": "Require a peer-judged masterwork completed over two-plus years before conferring standing, with the standing conferred by a cross-firm consortium that only recognises finished works, as pre-industrial guilds required a masterpiece."},
17	  {"id": "p6-015", "text": "Create a fixed, small number of publicly listed named seats with defined obligations, filled by open audition and vacated only by resignation, the way orchestras hold numbered chairs."},
18	  {"id": "p6-016", "text": "Underwrite the person's later independent venture with a guaranteed capital commitment payable at year seven, an obligation the firm carries for life, as monastic orders guarantee lifelong provision after profession."},
19	  {"id": "p6-017", "text": "Run a rotating draw fund where each cohort member takes the whole monthly pool in a fixed turn order and forfeits their unclaimed turn on leaving, as in ROSCA savings clubs."},
20	  {"id": "p6-018", "text": "Grant exclusive territory over a product line with a revenue share, a right of first refusal to buy it, and enforced standards, the way franchise agreements assign protected territories."},
21	  {"id": "p6-019", "text": "Keep a reciprocal-obligation ledger where people bank hours helping other teams and draw on the bank for their own projects, non-transferable outside, the way Amish barn-raising tallies mutual labour."},
22	  {"id": "p6-020", "text": "Sell forward claims on a person's next three years of output to internal and external buyers, paying them the proceeds now against delivery obligations, as Bordeaux sells en primeur wine futures."},
23	  {"id": "p6-021", "text": "Stop defending the individuals and buy the catchment: fund the upstream training institutions, bootcamps and university labs that produce them, the way water utilities buy watershed land instead of building filtration."},
24	  {"id": "p6-022", "text": "Syndicate each person's output rights across ten colleagues who each hold a small share of everyone else's bonus, so leaving abandons nine live claims, as thoroughbred breeding syndicates split shares in a stallion."},
25	  {"id": "p6-023", "text": "Give each person a living internal dataset or model instance that compounds only on your infrastructure and dies off it, handed over as their personal charge, like a sourdough starter that needs its own house flora."},

5	  {"id": "p1-003", "text": "Pay each specialist a perpetual royalty on revenue from the product line they built, continuing after they leave, but with the royalty base growing only while they keep shipping into it."},
6	  {"id": "p1-004", "text": "Buy a physical or data instrument that exists nowhere else in the market — a rig, a licensed corpus, a fleet — and give one specialist its operating keys."},
7	  {"id": "p1-005", "text": "Publish a standing price at which any employer may buy out a departing specialist's deferred claim, split the fee with the person, and run departures as football-style transfers."},
8	  {"id": "p1-006", "text": "Grant a standing right to take an outside job for up to two years and return to the same seat with tenure, stake and vesting clock unbroken, exercisable once."},
9	  {"id": "p1-007", "text": "Employ specialists three days a week and formally bless the other two for anyone else, so an outside offer forecloses nothing and there is no whole thing to leave."},
10	  {"id": "p1-008", "text": "Give a seven-year employment guarantee with an escalating severance floor, contractually binding the firm and not the person, renewed to seven years every anniversary."},
11	  {"id": "p1-009", "text": "Grant the full equity package at hire subject to a clawback that shrinks to zero over eight years, so the person is always wealthier by staying one more year rather than poorer by leaving."},
12	  {"id": "p1-010", "text": "Fund the specialist's own company as a subsidiary, take a minority stake, and let them run it as founder while remaining on payroll."},
13	  {"id": "p1-011", "text": "Contractually route inbound recruiter offers through the firm, pay a bounty for each forwarded, and commit to matching or beating by published formula within seventy-two hours."},
14	  {"id": "p1-012", "text": "Choose only projects whose feedback loop is longer than five years — regulatory, materials, longitudinal, physical — so nobody is fully effective at twelve months and the capability curve never flattens."},
15	  {"id": "p1-013", "text": "Pay part of compensation as a decade-long, personally directed research budget with guaranteed compute and lab time, drawable only while employed and never transferable."},
16	  {"id": "p1-014", "text": "Have the specialist hold copyright to what they write and license it to the firm on an annually renewing fee that escalates with tenure."},
17	  {"id": "p1-015", "text": "Stagger many small unvested claims at irregular dates set by project events rather than anniversaries, so no clean exit window ever opens."},
18	  {"id": "p1-016", "text": "Give each specialist an operating role in one internal venture plus board seats in three others, so their market-value peaks arrive staggered and none coincide."},
19	  {"id": "p1-017", "text": "Reset every person's pay to the highest verified outside offer received by anyone at their level in the firm that quarter, and post the number internally."},
20	  {"id": "p1-018", "text": "Make the person co-owner of the customer relationship with a contractual revenue share on named accounts that survives only under this firm's paper."},
21	  {"id": "p1-019", "text": "Cap total headcount by charter so ownership fractions can only concentrate, and publish each person's percentage and how it rises when others leave."},
22	  {"id": "p1-020", "text": "Domicile a public institution — a standards body, conference or journal — inside the firm and appoint the specialist its chair, funded and staffed."},
23	  {"id": "p1-021", "text": "When a large employer makes an offer, bid to acquire the project or team they wanted the person for, and give the person that mandate here."},
24	  {"id": "p1-022", "text": "Pay the first eight weeks entirely for writing the ramp path and tooling for their own role, so full effectiveness arrives at month three and the twelve-month clock never sets the rhythm."},
25	  {"id": "p1-023", "text": "Carry a below-market mortgage or housing loan on the firm's balance sheet that converts to an outright grant at year six."},
26	  {"id": "p1-024", "text": "Ship all significant work under a permanent two-person signature, assigning every specialist a fixed dyad partner, so the legible public artifact names a pair and not an individual."},
27	  {"id": "p1-025", "text": "Replace the fixed-term contract with a rolling multi-year agreement that auto-extends every quarter, so remaining requires no decision and leaving requires an affirmative one."},
28	  {"id": "p1-026", "text": "Keep a longitudinal instrumented record of each person's own decisions and outcomes over years, feed it back to them privately, and let them take a copy only on ten-year tenure."},
29	  {"id": "p1-027", "text": "Require every specialist to automate their previous job before starting the next one, and pay a bonus scaled to how much of their old role the machine now performs."},
30	  {"id": "p1-028", "text": "Underwrite the person's income against their own risk-taking: guarantee five years of pay at current level if a bet they personally chose fails publicly."},
31	  {"id": "p1-029", "text": "Write a dated, funded ten-year plan per person with capital committed at each milestone in advance, so the horizon on offer always exceeds any outside offer's horizon."},
32	  {"id": "p1-030", "text": "Sell a minority of each specialist's future firm-linked upside back to them for cash at hire, so they hold a bought asset rather than a granted one and would be selling, not quitting."}

16	  {"id": "p7-014", "text": "Let members publicly re-choose which leader they work under each quarter and pay leaders on choosers retained, the way client fish at reefs with multiple cleaning stations get measurably better service."},

18	  {"id": "p7-016", "text": "Require every project to extend the cultivated internal asset rather than start greenfield, the way Macrotermes termites can only digest wood through the Termitomyces comb they farm."},
19	  {"id": "p7-017", "text": "Run a documented mutual-aid ledger where members bank and redeem personal favours only inside, the way vampire bats regurgitate blood preferentially to individuals who fed them before."},
20	  {"id": "p7-018", "text": "Allocate the highest-value projects only to people who have already deposited a named successor into that same project, the way yuccas abort fruit from moths that oviposit without pollinating."},
21	  {"id": "p7-019", "text": "Recontract internal support allocation quarterly in proportion to output delivered, the way arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi deliver more phosphorus to roots supplying more carbon and less to freeloaders."},
22	  {"id": "p7-020", "text": "Rotate the lead of the hardest project on a fixed schedule so every senior member banks lead-time, the way bar-headed geese and ibises rotate the unshielded point of a V-formation."},

25	  {"id": "p7-023", "text": "Convene a standing forum where senior members evaluate each other's outside offers collectively, the way Temnothorax scouts refuse to commit to a new nest until a quorum of nestmates is present."},
26	  {"id": "p7-024", "text": "Scan public traces for what the market is currently hiring this person for and hand them that exact problem first, the way commensal Bacteroides pre-empt pathogens by occupying the mucosal nutrient niche."},
27	  {"id": "p7-025", "text": "Codify commitments as joint-signature obligations to named external partners that must be formally unwound to leave, like biofilm cells needing dispersin B to enzymatically dissolve the EPS matrix."},
28	  {"id": "p7-026", "text": "Let an expanding member take a funded paired bundle — one senior, one junior, capitalised — to open a new site under the firm's banner, the way lichens disperse as soredia containing both partners."},
29	  {"id": "p7-027", "text": "Schedule a protected low-exposure recovery period on the rota immediately after each intense delivery, the way emperor penguins circulate individuals from the huddle periphery into the warm core."},
30	  {"id": "p7-028", "text": "Build one idiosyncratic internal toolchain and language every member learns in their first ninety days, the way salmon imprint on natal-stream odorants during a narrow smoltification window."},
31	  {"id": "p7-029", "text": "Pay a public bounty for forwarding every unsolicited approach to a shared board, the way Pseudomyrmex acacia-ants patrol the host and attack encroaching vines and browsers on sight."},
32	  {"id": "p7-030", "text": "Cut the member into a co-owned legal entity sharing one balance sheet with the parent, the way Pando's aspen ramets stand as separate trunks on a single connected root system."}

5	  {"id": "p4-003", "text": "Spending almost nothing: hold a monthly binding vote in which the three specialists with the most shipped changes choose one thing the company will not do next quarter."},
6	  {"id": "p4-004", "text": "Spending almost nothing: buy each specialist a permanent personal domain and route a slice of real production traffic through a subdomain they personally control and administer."},
7	  {"id": "p4-005", "text": "Spending almost nothing: write into every contract that any individual pay revision applies retroactively to every peer at that level, making one person's negotiation raise the whole cohort's floor."},
8	  {"id": "p4-006", "text": "Spending almost nothing: publish the internal pay formula and its automatic quarterly indexation to a named public market rate, so nobody has to take an interview to learn their price."},
9	  {"id": "p4-007", "text": "This week: email every specialist a countersigned letter granting perpetual irrevocable licence to reuse any code they wrote here in any future employment, effective immediately."},
10	  {"id": "p4-008", "text": "Within seven days: ship a public page naming each specialist as owner of a specific customer-facing capability with their direct contact address, and let customers write to them."},
11	  {"id": "p4-009", "text": "Monday: switch all specialist pay to a formula recomputed monthly against a published market index, first recomputation this month, negotiation disabled."},
12	  {"id": "p4-010", "text": "By Friday: hand every specialist an undated, unconditional re-entry contract letting them return within five years at their departure level with no interview and no approval."},

15	  {"id": "p4-013", "text": "No humans: a bot mails each specialist a monthly ledger of their open threads, downstream dependents and who breaks if they stop, assembled straight from repository and ticket data."},
16	  {"id": "p4-014", "text": "No humans: run a standing internal auction where any team binds budget to a problem and specialists self-assign, with the system reallocating their time without approval."},
17	  {"id": "p4-015", "text": "No humans: machine-issue a cryptographically signed portable authorship record for every merged change, accruing only while employed and freezing permanently the day they leave."},
18	  {"id": "p4-016", "text": "No humans: let a system escalate each person's production permissions and blast radius purely as a function of tenure months, with the month-eighteen step the largest and irreversible."},

23	  {"id": "p4-021", "text": "For one named person: fund the company they would leave to found as a subsidiary, with the parent as its first paying customer."},
24	  {"id": "p4-022", "text": "For one named person: attach to them personally, not to their role, a permanent seat where their work's fate is decided — board observer, customer contract negotiations, pricing calls."},
25	  {"id": "p4-023", "text": "For one named person: underwrite their specific external ambition — a book, a published standard, a hardware run — with company money and time, scheduled to complete around month thirty."},
26	  {"id": "p4-024", "text": "At ten thousand times the headcount: publish a self-executing pay-and-authorship charter that anyone inside or outside can audit, with no discretionary carve-outs available to anyone at any level."},
27	  {"id": "p4-025", "text": "At ten thousand times the headcount: pay a continuous royalty on the measured usage of systems each person authored, paid monthly while employed and ceasing at departure."},

3	  {"id": "p5-001", "text": "Assume machine cognition is free: cut the year-to-effective to two weeks by having every specialist's working session recorded, transcribed and indexed into a queryable house corpus new hires interrogate instead of shadowing."},
4	  {"id": "p5-002", "text": "Give each specialist a private agent fleet fine-tuned on their own commits, docs and reviews, so their throughput here is three times what any unfamiliar codebase elsewhere would give them on day one."},
5	  {"id": "p5-003", "text": "Reprice every specialist quarterly against a scraped index of live posted ranges for their exact skill signature, adjusting automatically without anyone asking, so the package never lags twelve months behind."},
6	  {"id": "p5-004", "text": "Run continuous cheap simulation of the person's own departure: model who covers what, publish the gap to them, and fund whatever they say would make the gap not their problem."},
7	  {"id": "p5-005", "text": "Spend the now-cheap engineering on one bespoke internal tool per specialist, built to their personal workflow in a week, so their daily working environment is unreproducible anywhere else."},
8	  {"id": "p5-006", "text": "Let every specialist stand up a fully staffed synthetic org — planning, QA, docs, ops all agent-run — under their sole direction, giving one person the scope a fifty-person division used to require."},
9	  {"id": "p5-007", "text": "Because verification is now cheap, hand specialists irreversible production authority with automated rollback rather than approval queues, and publish each call they made under their name in a permanent decision log."},
10	  {"id": "p5-008", "text": "Shorten feedback loops to hours: instrument every change so the specialist sees measured real-world consequence of their own judgment the same day, at a cadence no large organisation's release train can match."},
11	  {"id": "p5-009", "text": "Maintain a cryptographically attested portable record of exactly what each person built, decided and shipped, issued to them continuously, and let the volume of it grow visibly faster here than anywhere."},
12	  {"id": "p5-010", "text": "Use free translation and summarisation to put every specialist directly in front of end customers weekly, no account manager in between, so they hold the relationship rather than a report about it."},
13	  {"id": "p5-011", "text": "Now that judgment is the scarce input, buy the person's judgment on the open market too: pay them a standing external-advisory retainer through the firm, so leaving forfeits an income stream, not a job."},
14	  {"id": "p5-012", "text": "Because output is cheap and originating data is not, route a proprietary live sensor, transaction or clinical stream exclusively to the specialist's desk so their next artifact cannot be produced elsewhere."},
15	  {"id": "p5-013", "text": "Give the specialist personal budget authority — a real number they sign against without approval — and raise it each quarter based on realised outcomes, making spending power the thing they'd surrender."},
16	  {"id": "p5-014", "text": "Name the individual specialist, not the company, in the customer contract as the accountable technical signatory, with the customer's consent, so departure is a visible breach of a named commitment."},
17	  {"id": "p5-015", "text": "Buy the firm a seat on a standards body, regulator working group or scientific consortium and put the specialist personally in it, so the external standing is conferred by staying."},
18	  {"id": "p5-016", "text": "Scarcity moves to uninterrupted human attention: guarantee each specialist four hours a week of scheduled time with a named world-class outside expert, paid for and booked by the firm."},
19	  {"id": "p5-017", "text": "Attach a deferred consequence payment to specific decisions the specialist signed, measured against real outcomes three to five years later, payable only to whoever is still accountable for that system."},
20	  {"id": "p5-018", "text": "Give the specialist first refusal to spin their line out as a majority-owned company with the firm as anchor customer, exercisable at any point after eighteen months."},
21	  {"id": "p5-019", "text": "Because writing code is cheap and physical access is not, place the specialist on-site inside the customer's plant, lab or ward one week a month with hands on the actual apparatus."},
22	  {"id": "p5-020", "text": "Let each specialist personally hire and direct two people of their choosing on a problem they chose, so leaving means abandoning colleagues they recruited rather than colleagues assigned to them."},
23	  {"id": "p5-021", "text": "Auction internal problems: publish the firm's hardest open questions with attached budget and let specialists bid to own one outright for a year, ownership transferring to nobody in the interim."},
24	  {"id": "p5-022", "text": "Hold a rolling personal research fund in the specialist's name that they can spend on anything, accruing monthly and vesting only into use, not cash, so its value exists solely inside the firm."},
25	  {"id": "p5-023", "text": "Because reconstructing context is now nearly free, stop treating institutional knowledge as the moat and instead give the specialist unshareable licence rights — data, patent, clinical access — held in their name via the firm."},
26	  {"id": "p5-024", "text": "Make peer scarcity your asset: recruit a deliberately dense cluster of four to six specialists in one narrow subfield who all sit together, so leaving means leaving the densest room in that subfield."},
27	  {"id": "p5-025", "text": "Fund and publish the specialist's own long-running public artifact — dataset, benchmark, registry — under their name, hosted by the firm, whose continued maintenance requires the firm's infrastructure and their continued presence."},
28	  {"id": "p5-026", "text": "Cheap cognition makes taste the bottleneck: give the specialist final unappealable veto over one named product surface, documented publicly, and never overrule it."},
29	  {"id": "p5-027", "text": "Run a quarterly forecast of when each person's reasons to stay expire, generated from their own logged work, and act on the forecast a full quarter before the predicted date."},
30	  {"id": "p5-028", "text": "Because compute is the new raw material, allocate each specialist a personal cluster reservation larger than a big employer's per-head quota, dedicated, not queued, and let them see the reservation grow."},
31	  {"id": "p5-029", "text": "Give the specialist standing to publish negative and failed results from the firm's proprietary work, pre-cleared for release, since no larger organisation's legal function will grant that."},
32	  {"id": "p5-030", "text": "Sell the specialist an option, not equity: the right to buy the asset they built — model weights, tool, dataset — at a fixed price if the firm ever shelves it."}
33	 ]}

4	  {"id": "p8-002", "text": "Fund an irrevocable third-party trust that pays the person a fixed annuity for five years starting the day they leave, with the annuity size set by months served and never forfeitable."},
5	  {"id": "p8-003", "text": "Index base pay to a published external compensation benchmark, reprice quarterly by formula with no negotiation and no ratchet down, and publish the formula in the employment contract."},
6	  {"id": "p8-004", "text": "Post a bond with an escrow agent payable to the person if the firm cancels their project, is acquired, or misses contractually stated resourcing levels, audited annually by the escrow agent."},
7	  {"id": "p8-005", "text": "Hire in sealed cohorts of five under one joint instrument where the cohort's pooled payout unlocks only when four of the five reach year four, and let the cohort admit its own replacements."},
8	  {"id": "p8-006", "text": "Co-sign the person to a named external customer who pays part of their compensation directly and whose written release is required before the assignment ends."},
9	  {"id": "p8-007", "text": "Charter a five-firm alliance in which tenure, deferred pay and seniority travel intact between members, so the person can change employer without resetting anything, but only inside the alliance."},
10	  {"id": "p8-008", "text": "Capitalise a separate legal entity the specialist owns half of, contribute the firm's engineering and customers to it, and let the firm's half convert to the person's on a revenue schedule."},
11	  {"id": "p8-009", "text": "Contract the person for three days a week and become the anchor client of the business they run on the other two, with a five-year minimum spend commitment."},
12	  {"id": "p8-010", "text": "Buy an insurance policy in the person's name that pays a lump sum on strategy pivot, acquisition or product cancellation, so the firm's own instability is underwritten by a third party."},
13	  {"id": "p8-011", "text": "Attach a named, permanent technical veto seat over one architecture domain that vests at month thirty, is recorded in the company's governing documents, and lapses on departure."},
14	  {"id": "p8-012", "text": "Pay part of compensation as an assignable, inheritable royalty on one product's revenue that keeps accruing after departure only while the person remains its contracted maintainer."},
15	  {"id": "p8-013", "text": "Ship a product surface under the specialist's own name with the user relationship contractually theirs, and keep operating and supporting it for them as long as they stay."},
16	  {"id": "p8-014", "text": "Buy an exclusive licence to a restricted corpus, facility or regulated dataset whose access terms name individual employees, and put the specialist on the named-access list."},
17	  {"id": "p8-015", "text": "Write the specialist a transferable ten-year call option on their own job at today's title and terms, exercisable at any time, so departure is a suspension rather than an end."},
18	  {"id": "p8-016", "text": "Run an internal auction in which the specialist bids their quarters against funded projects, keeps a fixed share of the budget they underspend, and cannot be assigned outside the auction."},
19	  {"id": "p8-017", "text": "Make notice symmetric and priced: either party may end the arrangement on six months' notice, the ending party pays the other a fixed published sum, and the person may sell their side of that right back to the firm."},
20	  {"id": "p8-018", "text": "Fund an irrevocable education trust for the person's named dependants, with contributions continuing ten years past departure once tenure passes four years and stopping dead before it."},
21	  {"id": "p8-019", "text": "Pay the specialist to run a formal open auction of their own services every twelve months, then either match the clearing price or release them with a scheduled settlement."},
22	  {"id": "p8-020", "text": "Lend the person the cash to buy a real ownership stake at appraised value, with the loan repayable in full on departure and forgiven at a fixed rate per year served."},
23	  {"id": "p8-021", "text": "End every engagement on a stated date, take the person off payroll for one month with an exit payment, and re-sign a fresh instrument each time, so leaving is routine rather than terminal."},
24	  {"id": "p8-022", "text": "Denominate deferred pay in successors: the person's deferred account credits a fixed sum for each engineer they certify, and an external assessor tests the successor before crediting."},
25	  {"id": "p8-023", "text": "Sign a binding term sheet today to fund the person's own venture at a pre-agreed valuation in year four, with the firm as passive minority holder and no right of first refusal."},
26	  {"id": "p8-024", "text": "Offer annually to buy twelve months of exclusivity at a price the specialist names, pay it in cash up front, and require nothing if they decline the offer."},
27	  {"id": "p8-025", "text": "Hand the specialist full allocation of their own time with no assignment authority anywhere in the firm, and pay them a measured share of the value their chosen work produces."},
28	  {"id": "p8-026", "text": "Hold the firm's seat on a standards body, regulator working group or benchmark committee in the specialist's personal name for the duration of their employment."},
29	  {"id": "p8-027", "text": "Arrange a standing swap with a non-competing firm: each sends one specialist to the other for six months a year, with both clocks and both deferred accounts running continuously."},
30	  {"id": "p8-028", "text": "Grant a portable compute-and-lab credit line, redeemable at any employer or none, that is worth nothing in year one and full face value in year five, and let them spend it on anything technical."},
31	  {"id": "p8-029", "text": "Give the specialist unilateral authority to hire three people onto a budget they control for five years, with the authority written as a personal grant that dies with their employment."},
32	  {"id": "p8-030", "text": "Let the specialist name the acquirer veto: write into the shareholders' agreement that their named technical domain cannot be sold, licensed or shut down without their signature while employed."}
33	 ]}

1	{"lens": "First principles", "pool": 2,
2	 "items": [
3	  {"id": "p2-001", "text": "Treat the twelve-month ramp as a variable rather than a constant: fund a standing team whose only measured output is cutting time-to-first-independent-shipment to six weeks."},
4	  {"id": "p2-002", "text": "Recruit only from people already ramped at their own expense — your customers, your contractors, and outside developers who have shipped against your API."},
5	  {"id": "p2-003", "text": "Pay the ramp cost as a cash loan at signing, forgiven one thirty-sixth per month and repayable on departure, with the outstanding balance shown on every payslip."},
6	  {"id": "p2-004", "text": "Back-load the wage curve: 70 percent of market for months zero to twelve, 140 percent from month eighteen, with the accrued gap stated as a running number."},
7	  {"id": "p2-005", "text": "Index every salary to a published external compensation benchmark and recompute it monthly by formula, so no human ever makes a repricing decision."},
8	  {"id": "p2-006", "text": "Assign each senior person a named percentage of the gross margin of the specific product line they own, paid quarterly, ending the day they leave."},
9	  {"id": "p2-007", "text": "Sell secondments instead of losing people: lease the person to the large employer for six paid months under a contract that returns them."},
10	  {"id": "p2-008", "text": "Replace open-ended employment with a two-year fixed term carrying a completion payment of six months' salary, forfeited entirely on early exit."},
11	  {"id": "p2-009", "text": "Stop employing; buy three days a week from people who keep their own company and other clients, so changing employer is never a reason to leave you."},
12	  {"id": "p2-010", "text": "Become the issuer of the credential: run a public, externally examined certification in your domain that can only be earned by doing your work."},
13	  {"id": "p2-011", "text": "Give the person legal ownership of the tool they build and take back an exclusive licence that lapses when their employment does."},
14	  {"id": "p2-012", "text": "Acquire one asset a large employer cannot obtain — a licensed facility, a sole-source dataset, a physical instrument — and route the role's daily work through it."},
15	  {"id": "p2-013", "text": "Contract with the household rather than the individual: guarantee a spouse's employment placement, childcare, or relocation package that terminates with the employment."},
16	  {"id": "p2-014", "text": "Sell shares for real money at a discount, requiring the person to write an actual cheque, so leaving means liquidating something they bought."},
17	  {"id": "p2-015", "text": "Accept eighteen-month tenure as a design constant: spend a fixed fifth of engineering capacity turning every project into a written artifact any contractor can resume in a week."},
18	  {"id": "p2-016", "text": "Pay a departing person a bounty equal to the full ramp cost for sourcing and fully training their own replacement before they go."},
19	  {"id": "p2-017", "text": "Hire every role in pairs from the start, so no single departure removes accumulated effectiveness and the second person carries the context forward."},
20	  {"id": "p2-018", "text": "Put the individual's name on the customer contract as the delivery principal, so the client relationship is personal, legally lodged here, and non-portable."},
21	  {"id": "p2-019", "text": "Halve the roadmap, halve the headcount, and pay the survivors 1.5x market from a budget that was already being spent."},
22	  {"id": "p2-020", "text": "Sign a formal feeder agreement with the large employers who poach: they pay an agreed placement fee per hire, and you plan the pipeline around it."},
23	  {"id": "p2-021", "text": "Convert the ownership structure so working staff hold the controlling block and vote on direction, and make the vote extinguish on the day someone leaves."},
24	  {"id": "p2-022", "text": "Establish a deferred trust that pays out over years after a four-year cliff, funded annually per head, forfeited in full before the cliff."},
25	  {"id": "p2-023", "text": "Buy the years outright: pay a transfer-fee-style lump sum today for a legally enforceable four-year exclusive commitment, priced against replacement cost."},
26	  {"id": "p2-024", "text": "Hand over legal signing authority and a bank mandate on day one, so the scarce good on offer is elapsed time rather than scope."},
27	  {"id": "p2-025", "text": "Operate as the person's agent for inbound offers: they route every unsolicited approach to you, you negotiate, and you take a stated percentage of any move you place them into."},
28	  {"id": "p2-026", "text": "Do the work under a licence or accreditation only your firm holds, so the accumulated skill is legally exercisable in very few other places."},
29	  {"id": "p2-027", "text": "Invoice the training explicitly: a signed schedule listing the cost of each month of ramp, repayable pro rata for thirty-six months on exit."},
30	  {"id": "p2-028", "text": "Write the person's name into the shipped artifact as its published author, and keep publishing under that name only while they remain."},
31	  {"id": "p2-029", "text": "Sponsor visas and absorb the immigration legal work yourself, recruiting from labour markets where large local employers do not compete for the same person."},
32	  {"id": "p2-030", "text": "Replace annual salary with a per-outcome price list, paying a fixed sum per shipped deliverable, so earnings rise with capability without any review event."}
33	 ]}

3	  {"id": "p9-001", "text": "Invert the employment contract into a client contract: the specialist incorporates, invoices the firm, and the firm signs a three-year minimum-spend agreement with a break fee the specialist pays if they terminate early."},
4	  {"id": "p9-002", "text": "Let the specialist bill the firm for services and simultaneously bill two external clients through the firm's contracting entity, with the firm taking a booking fee, so leaving means losing the client book the firm sourced."},
5	  {"id": "p9-003", "text": "Make the specialist the purchaser of internal services: give them an annual budget in real currency to buy compute, contractors, designers and legal from inside the firm, forfeited entirely on departure."},
6	  {"id": "p9-004", "text": "Hire the recruiter as your customer: pay the sourcing agencies a fee to route their best candidates through your firm first as a paid trial staffing bench, making you the supplier the big employers buy from."},
7	  {"id": "p9-005", "text": "Sell the larger organisation a secondment: place your specialist inside the big firm for six months at a marked-up day rate, contractually returning, so the big firm gets the person without hiring them."},
8	  {"id": "p9-006", "text": "Rent the large competitor as infrastructure by running your specialist's work on their platform under a named-partner agreement, making the specialist a publicly credited external authority whose title dissolves if they become an ordinary internal employee there."},
9	  {"id": "p9-007", "text": "Make the specialist the counterparty to your investors: allocate them a small direct carry position in the fund's stake, administered by the investors, that vests over five years and is legally the investors' obligation, not the firm's."},
10	  {"id": "p9-008", "text": "Give the specialist a named customer account they own commercially — they sign the contract, they get a percentage of its revenue for as long as the account renews and they remain the signatory."},
11	  {"id": "p9-009", "text": "Reverse the interview: run a formal annual process in which the specialist evaluates and scores the firm against a written service-level agreement, with automatic contractual remedies to them if the firm fails its own commitments."},
12	  {"id": "p9-010", "text": "Make departing specialists your distribution channel by paying them a standing commission for every customer, hire or contract they route to you afterwards, with the commission stream void if they join a listed set of large competitors."},
13	  {"id": "p9-011", "text": "Treat the specialist's household as the counterparty: sign a five-year agreement with the partner or family covering relocation costs, schooling deposits or mortgage buy-down that the household, not the specialist, would have to repay on early exit."},
14	  {"id": "p9-012", "text": "Let the specialist become the employer of a two-person team they hire, budget and pay from a P&L you assign them, so leaving means dissolving people who work for them personally."},
15	  {"id": "p9-013", "text": "Sell your customers the specialist directly: publish them as a named guaranteed resource in customer contracts with a service credit if they leave, and share the resulting premium price with them."},
16	  {"id": "p9-014", "text": "Become the recruiter's supplier of last resort: sign a contract with the large firms' talent teams to place your alumni for a fee, and give the specialist a cut of every placement made from their referral."},
17	  {"id": "p9-015", "text": "Have the specialist buy a stake: offer them the right to purchase real shares with their own money at a set valuation, financed by a firm loan forgiven over five years of continued shareholding."},
18	  {"id": "p9-016", "text": "Flip who owns the intellectual property: assign the specialist personal ownership of the tooling they build, licensed to the firm perpetually with an annual royalty paid to them that stops if they compete."},
19	  {"id": "p9-017", "text": "Make peers the buyers of each other's time: run an internal market where specialists sell blocks of their hours to other teams for budget they keep and spend, building a personal balance forfeited on exit."},
20	  {"id": "p9-018", "text": "Turn the outside offer into an asset you buy: pay the specialist a standing quarterly fee to forward every unsolicited approach, price and terms, and use the aggregated data as a product you sell back to peers."},
21	  {"id": "p9-019", "text": "Make the investors the specialist's direct employer of record for a portion of their time, seconded into your firm, so the investment fund's relationship and its portfolio-wide network is what they would be walking away from."},
22	  {"id": "p9-020", "text": "Let the specialist commission the firm's roadmap: give them a binding annual vote weighted by tenure over which projects get funded, so influence accrues arithmetically and resets to zero at any new employer."},
23	  {"id": "p9-021", "text": "Position the firm as the specialist's agent rather than their employer: negotiate their outside speaking, advisory and board seats for a 15 percent cut, and make the agency agreement exclusive and five-year."},
24	  {"id": "p9-022", "text": "Charge the large competitor for access: sell a paid technical-partnership tier whose only deliverable is scheduled consultation hours with your named specialist, and pay the specialist the majority of that fee personally."},
25	  {"id": "p9-023", "text": "Make the customers the appraisers and the payers: let key customers vote an annual bonus pool directly to named individuals, funded from a line in their contract, paid only to people still present at year end."},
26	  {"id": "p9-024", "text": "Reverse the notice period's direction: guarantee the specialist eighteen months of paid notice if you ever terminate them, contingent on them holding a symmetric twelve-month notice obligation to you."},
27	  {"id": "p9-025", "text": "Let the specialist underwrite the firm: allow them to defer a slice of salary into a note that pays a high fixed coupon, redeemable only after year four, so they hold the firm as an investment."},
28	  {"id": "p9-026", "text": "Make peers the hiring committee for their own replacement budget: give each senior specialist a personal headcount allocation they recruit and retain, and pay them a per-head annual stipend for every hire still present."},
29	  {"id": "p9-027", "text": "Have the specialist buy insurance from you: sell an income-continuity product priced below market that covers them through any future unemployment, underwritten by the firm and cancelled on voluntary departure."},
30	  {"id": "p9-028", "text": "Make the larger organisation your training customer: run paid certification courses taught by your specialist that the big firms send their staff to, so the specialist's market position is being their instructor, not their employee."},
31	  {"id": "p9-029", "text": "Let the household hold the option: grant the specialist's named partner a separate, transferable stake in the firm that vests on the specialist's fifth year, so the exit decision has a second economic voter."},
32	  {"id": "p9-030", "text": "Have the specialist set their own price annually as a supplier would — submit a rate card, defend it, and the firm either pays it or releases them — with a two-year fixed term signed at each agreed rate."}
33	 ]}

6	  {"id": "p3-004", "text": "Give each person a named external constituency they personally hold while employed: a standards-body seat, a regulator relationship, or three named customer accounts that route to them directly."},
7	  {"id": "p3-005", "text": "Build one proprietary instrument, dataset or test rig that exists nowhere else, and give every technical hire unlimited unsupervised access to it."},
8	  {"id": "p3-006", "text": "Deliberately let one person become the only living expert on a commercially load-bearing subject, and say so publicly and by name in writing to customers."},
9	  {"id": "p3-007", "text": "Let anyone past 18 months propose a new unit, and if accepted give them the headcount requisitions, budget line and hiring authority to staff it themselves."},
10	  {"id": "p3-008", "text": "Acquire an employee's existing side project into the company as a subsidiary they continue to run, with a minority stake retained by them."},
11	  {"id": "p3-009", "text": "Re-price every salary quarterly against live market data by published formula, applied automatically without anyone asking or negotiating."},
12	  {"id": "p3-010", "text": "Compress ramp to 90 days with a paid full-time overlap shadow and a pre-built environment, so the hardest work starts in month four rather than month thirteen."},
13	  {"id": "p3-011", "text": "Keep a sealed queue of the firm's three hardest unsolved problems and release one only to a person past month ten, one at a time."},
14	  {"id": "p3-012", "text": "Offer each person the right to buy real money into their own project at a fixed valuation, with a defined buy-back at the outcome date."},
15	  {"id": "p3-013", "text": "Commit in writing to spinning out any unit that reaches defined revenue, with its lead becoming founder and cap-table holder of the spinout."},
16	  {"id": "p3-014", "text": "Every nine months, make each person a fresh written competing bid for their next eighteen months: named problem, scope, money, dated, delivered before recruiters get there."},
17	  {"id": "p3-015", "text": "Pay a royalty to the builder whenever internal tooling they wrote is licensed, sold or used by a customer, continuing while they remain."},
18	  {"id": "p3-016", "text": "Run a board-certification-style residency: a 24-month sequence with logged cases and an external examination, awarded only on completion, the way medical fellowships work."},
19	  {"id": "p3-017", "text": "Structure work as rolling 24-month commitments that begin every eight months, so a person is always mid-way through two of them at once."},
20	  {"id": "p3-018", "text": "Provide a housing loan or rent subsidy near the workplace that forgives over four years, settled at exit."},
21	  {"id": "p3-019", "text": "Convert people at 18 months onto a partner-style arrangement: a percentage of fees on work they originate, paid for as long as the client stays."},
22	  {"id": "p3-020", "text": "Bid for one project whose blast radius exceeds anything a large firm would ever hand a single mid-career person, and hand it to a single mid-career person."},
23	  {"id": "p3-021", "text": "Pay a quarterly bonus for forwarding unsolicited recruiter mail into a shared channel where the firm posts, publicly, what it would and would not match."},
24	  {"id": "p3-022", "text": "Give each person past twelve months a discretionary capital budget they spend unilaterally with no approval, scaling with tenure, reported after the fact."},
25	  {"id": "p3-023", "text": "Grant employees named ownership of IP they author, vesting to them over four years, licensed back to the firm perpetually and royalty-free."},
26	  {"id": "p3-024", "text": "Host and fund a small invite-only external research circle, and give each senior employee a seat in it that reverts to the firm when they leave."},
27	  {"id": "p3-025", "text": "Publish per-person friction metrics — approvals required, idea-to-production days, people who can veto you — so any large-employer offer can be compared numerically against them."},
28	  {"id": "p3-026", "text": "Offer a guaranteed seat back within twelve months, in writing, to anyone who takes a job at a larger employer, with tenure and deferred payouts continuing."},
29	  {"id": "p3-027", "text": "Write a scope covenant into the contract: defined expansion of authority at fixed dates, or a liquidated cash payment to the employee if missed."},
30	  {"id": "p3-028", "text": "Recruit intact pairs and trios who have worked together before, staff them as a unit, and let them accept or reject work as a unit."},
31	  {"id": "p3-029", "text": "Choose a line of business that large employers are structurally conflicted out of — competing with their clients, or under a licence they cannot hold — and make it the core work."},
32	  {"id": "p3-030", "text": "Cap headcount publicly at a fixed number, never exceed it, and fill any opening by internal claim before external hiring."},
33	  {"id": "p3-031", "text": "Recruit people whose constraint large employers cannot serve — fixed caregiving hours, remote geography, medical schedule — and design the role and delivery model around that constraint."}

3	  {"id": "p6-001", "text": "Pay a percentage of each shipped product's realized revenue for three years after it ships rather than a salary premium, settled quarterly, the way commercial fishing crews take a lay share of the catch after the voyage lands."},
4	  {"id": "p6-002", "text": "Run a cohort pot: fix a large sum per hiring class, divide it only among members still present at year four, and publish the rising per-head figure monthly, as in a tontine."},
5	  {"id": "p6-003", "text": "Contract in bonded groups of four with a single joint fee split by the group, so any one departure cuts the other three's pay, as string quartets and chamber ensembles sign as an ensemble."},
6	  {"id": "p6-004", "text": "Keep every person holding two firm-dated project commitments eighteen and thirty months out, signed pay-or-play with named start dates, the way film crews are booked forward across pictures."},
7	  {"id": "p6-005", "text": "Give each person a land-trust-style split: they own their improvements outright and sell them back at a formula price on exit, while the firm holds the underlying platform, as in community land trusts."},
8	  {"id": "p6-006", "text": "Re-strike every package automatically each quarter against a published external index of market rates with no negotiation and no manager discretion, the way offshore drilling contracts index day-rates."},
9	  {"id": "p6-007", "text": "Make people members with share capital and an annual patronage dividend proportional to their contribution, redeemable at book value only, the way credit unions treat departing members."},
10	  {"id": "p6-008", "text": "Permanently attach the person's name to the systems they originate in a public registry the firm maintains and keeps updating for decades, the way first-ascent registries credit climbing routes."},
11	  {"id": "p6-009", "text": "Disclose the proprietary internals in staged degrees at fixed tenure thresholds, with each stage genuinely unavailable earlier and useless out of context, as Masonic degrees release knowledge on a fixed progression."},
12	  {"id": "p6-010", "text": "Put each person's flagship project into a dated maturation programme with a public bottling date years out, where only the named creator may release it, as whisky casks name their distiller."},
13	  {"id": "p6-011", "text": "Fund the person to found a majority-independent subsidiary you part-own at the moment their value peaks, deliberately splitting the group, the way beekeepers make an artificial swarm before a colony absconds."},
14	  {"id": "p6-012", "text": "Loan people formally to rival institutions for fixed terms with signed return dates and shared output rights, the way zoos exchange animals under studbook breeding loans."},
15	  {"id": "p6-013", "text": "Hire on voyage articles: fixed multi-year terms tied to a named mission, with the accumulated wage paid as a lump at term's end, as merchant seamen sign ship's articles per voyage."},
16	  {"id": "p6-014", "text": "Require a peer-judged masterwork completed over two-plus years before conferring standing, with the standing conferred by a cross-firm consortium that only recognises finished works, as pre-industrial guilds required a masterpiece."},
17	  {"id": "p6-015", "text": "Create a fixed, small number of publicly listed named seats with defined obligations, filled by open audition and vacated only by resignation, the way orchestras hold numbered chairs."},
18	  {"id": "p6-016", "text": "Underwrite the person's later independent venture with a guaranteed capital commitment payable at year seven, an obligation the firm carries for life, as monastic orders guarantee lifelong provision after profession."},
19	  {"id": "p6-017", "text": "Run a rotating draw fund where each cohort member takes the whole monthly pool in a fixed turn order and forfeits their unclaimed turn on leaving, as in ROSCA savings clubs."},
20	  {"id": "p6-018", "text": "Grant exclusive territory over a product line with a revenue share, a right of first refusal to buy it, and enforced standards, the way franchise agreements assign protected territories."},

22	  {"id": "p6-020", "text": "Sell forward claims on a person's next three years of output to internal and external buyers, paying them the proceeds now against delivery obligations, as Bordeaux sells en primeur wine futures."},
23	  {"id": "p6-021", "text": "Stop defending the individuals and buy the catchment: fund the upstream training institutions, bootcamps and university labs that produce them, the way water utilities buy watershed land instead of building filtration."},
24	  {"id": "p6-022", "text": "Syndicate each person's output rights across ten colleagues who each hold a small share of everyone else's bonus, so leaving abandons nine live claims, as thoroughbred breeding syndicates split shares in a stallion."},
25	  {"id": "p6-023", "text": "Give each person a living internal dataset or model instance that compounds only on your infrastructure and dies off it, handed over as their personal charge, like a sourdough starter that needs its own house flora."},
26	  {"id": "p6-024", "text": "Build a formal corridor: pre-agree with five non-competing firms that people move between you on declared terms with return rights, the way wildlife corridors connect reserves rather than fencing each one."},
27	  {"id": "p6-025", "text": "Post permanent physical boards in the building recording every completed system, its date, and every name on it, unveiled at a ceremony, the way change-ringing towers hang peal boards."},
28	  {"id": "p6-026", "text": "Mutualise the downside: form a members' club where each person contributes to a pool that covers members' failed projects and pays surplus back after five years, as Lloyd's names and P&I clubs share risk."},
29	  {"id": "p6-027", "text": "Name the workshop, not the person: let each senior person inherit and later pass on a titled studio line with its own archive and successor, as Japanese kiln lineages transmit a workshop name across generations."},
30	  {"id": "p6-028", "text": "Require a mandatory two-year unpaid recall option in every contract, with a retainer paid throughout, so departure is structurally a leave rather than a break, as ballet companies retain guest-artist first call."},
31	  {"id": "p6-029", "text": "Levy a reserve contribution from every project budget into a fund each person votes to allocate to long-horizon internal work, with voting rights lost on exit, the way condominium boards control reserve funds."},
32	  {"id": "p6-030", "text": "Assign each person a decade-long numbered commission whose completion date is publicly carved into the artefact, with credit attaching only at completion, as cathedral lodges recorded masons' marks on finished courses."}

16	  {"id": "p7-014", "text": "Let members publicly re-choose which leader they work under each quarter and pay leaders on choosers retained, the way client fish at reefs with multiple cleaning stations get measurably better service."},
17	  {"id": "p7-015", "text": "Front-load a locked-room three-month co-build with one named partner in the first quarter, the way prairie vole partner preference forms during a critical window of vasopressin V1aR signalling."},
18	  {"id": "p7-016", "text": "Require every project to extend the cultivated internal asset rather than start greenfield, the way Macrotermes termites can only digest wood through the Termitomyces comb they farm."},
19	  {"id": "p7-017", "text": "Run a documented mutual-aid ledger where members bank and redeem personal favours only inside, the way vampire bats regurgitate blood preferentially to individuals who fed them before."},
20	  {"id": "p7-018", "text": "Allocate the highest-value projects only to people who have already deposited a named successor into that same project, the way yuccas abort fruit from moths that oviposit without pollinating."},

22	  {"id": "p7-020", "text": "Rotate the lead of the hardest project on a fixed schedule so every senior member banks lead-time, the way bar-headed geese and ibises rotate the unshielded point of a V-formation."},
23	  {"id": "p7-021", "text": "Give each member a permanently hosted public artifact under their own name that the firm maintains forever, the way male bowerbirds build and endlessly repair a bower females return to inspect."},

25	  {"id": "p7-023", "text": "Convene a standing forum where senior members evaluate each other's outside offers collectively, the way Temnothorax scouts refuse to commit to a new nest until a quorum of nestmates is present."},
26	  {"id": "p7-024", "text": "Scan public traces for what the market is currently hiring this person for and hand them that exact problem first, the way commensal Bacteroides pre-empt pathogens by occupying the mucosal nutrient niche."},
27	  {"id": "p7-025", "text": "Codify commitments as joint-signature obligations to named external partners that must be formally unwound to leave, like biofilm cells needing dispersin B to enzymatically dissolve the EPS matrix."},
28	  {"id": "p7-026", "text": "Let an expanding member take a funded paired bundle — one senior, one junior, capitalised — to open a new site under the firm's banner, the way lichens disperse as soredia containing both partners."},
29	  {"id": "p7-027", "text": "Schedule a protected low-exposure recovery period on the rota immediately after each intense delivery, the way emperor penguins circulate individuals from the huddle periphery into the warm core."},
30	  {"id": "p7-028", "text": "Build one idiosyncratic internal toolchain and language every member learns in their first ninety days, the way salmon imprint on natal-stream odorants during a narrow smoltification window."},
31	  {"id": "p7-029", "text": "Pay a public bounty for forwarding every unsolicited approach to a shared board, the way Pseudomyrmex acacia-ants patrol the host and attack encroaching vines and browsers on sight."},
32	  {"id": "p7-030", "text": "Cut the member into a co-owned legal entity sharing one balance sheet with the parent, the way Pando's aspen ramets stand as separate trunks on a single connected root system."}

8	  {"id": "p1-006", "text": "Grant a standing right to take an outside job for up to two years and return to the same seat with tenure, stake and vesting clock unbroken, exercisable once."},
9	  {"id": "p1-007", "text": "Employ specialists three days a week and formally bless the other two for anyone else, so an outside offer forecloses nothing and there is no whole thing to leave."},
10	  {"id": "p1-008", "text": "Give a seven-year employment guarantee with an escalating severance floor, contractually binding the firm and not the person, renewed to seven years every anniversary."},
11	  {"id": "p1-009", "text": "Grant the full equity package at hire subject to a clawback that shrinks to zero over eight years, so the person is always wealthier by staying one more year rather than poorer by leaving."},
12	  {"id": "p1-010", "text": "Fund the specialist's own company as a subsidiary, take a minority stake, and let them run it as founder while remaining on payroll."},
13	  {"id": "p1-011", "text": "Contractually route inbound recruiter offers through the firm, pay a bounty for each forwarded, and commit to matching or beating by published formula within seventy-two hours."},
14	  {"id": "p1-012", "text": "Choose only projects whose feedback loop is longer than five years — regulatory, materials, longitudinal, physical — so nobody is fully effective at twelve months and the capability curve never flattens."},
15	  {"id": "p1-013", "text": "Pay part of compensation as a decade-long, personally directed research budget with guaranteed compute and lab time, drawable only while employed and never transferable."},
16	  {"id": "p1-014", "text": "Have the specialist hold copyright to what they write and license it to the firm on an annually renewing fee that escalates with tenure."},
17	  {"id": "p1-015", "text": "Stagger many small unvested claims at irregular dates set by project events rather than anniversaries, so no clean exit window ever opens."},
18	  {"id": "p1-016", "text": "Give each specialist an operating role in one internal venture plus board seats in three others, so their market-value peaks arrive staggered and none coincide."},
19	  {"id": "p1-017", "text": "Reset every person's pay to the highest verified outside offer received by anyone at their level in the firm that quarter, and post the number internally."},
20	  {"id": "p1-018", "text": "Make the person co-owner of the customer relationship with a contractual revenue share on named accounts that survives only under this firm's paper."},
21	  {"id": "p1-019", "text": "Cap total headcount by charter so ownership fractions can only concentrate, and publish each person's percentage and how it rises when others leave."},
22	  {"id": "p1-020", "text": "Domicile a public institution — a standards body, conference or journal — inside the firm and appoint the specialist its chair, funded and staffed."},
23	  {"id": "p1-021", "text": "When a large employer makes an offer, bid to acquire the project or team they wanted the person for, and give the person that mandate here."},
24	  {"id": "p1-022", "text": "Pay the first eight weeks entirely for writing the ramp path and tooling for their own role, so full effectiveness arrives at month three and the twelve-month clock never sets the rhythm."},
25	  {"id": "p1-023", "text": "Carry a below-market mortgage or housing loan on the firm's balance sheet that converts to an outright grant at year six."},
26	  {"id": "p1-024", "text": "Ship all significant work under a permanent two-person signature, assigning every specialist a fixed dyad partner, so the legible public artifact names a pair and not an individual."},
27	  {"id": "p1-025", "text": "Replace the fixed-term contract with a rolling multi-year agreement that auto-extends every quarter, so remaining requires no decision and leaving requires an affirmative one."},
28	  {"id": "p1-026", "text": "Keep a longitudinal instrumented record of each person's own decisions and outcomes over years, feed it back to them privately, and let them take a copy only on ten-year tenure."},
29	  {"id": "p1-027", "text": "Require every specialist to automate their previous job before starting the next one, and pay a bonus scaled to how much of their old role the machine now performs."},
30	  {"id": "p1-028", "text": "Underwrite the person's income against their own risk-taking: guarantee five years of pay at current level if a bet they personally chose fails publicly."},
31	  {"id": "p1-029", "text": "Write a dated, funded ten-year plan per person with capital committed at each milestone in advance, so the horizon on offer always exceeds any outside offer's horizon."},
32	  {"id": "p1-030", "text": "Sell a minority of each specialist's future firm-linked upside back to them for cash at hire, so they hold a bought asset rather than a granted one and would be selling, not quitting."}

23	  {"id": "p8-021", "text": "End every engagement on a stated date, take the person off payroll for one month with an exit payment, and re-sign a fresh instrument each time, so leaving is routine rather than terminal."},

26	  {"id": "p8-024", "text": "Offer annually to buy twelve months of exclusivity at a price the specialist names, pay it in cash up front, and require nothing if they decline the offer."},

30	  {"id": "p8-028", "text": "Grant a portable compute-and-lab credit line, redeemable at any employer or none, that is worth nothing in year one and full face value in year five, and let them spend it on anything technical."},
31	  {"id": "p8-029", "text": "Give the specialist unilateral authority to hire three people onto a budget they control for five years, with the authority written as a personal grant that dies with their employment."},
32	  {"id": "p8-030", "text": "Let the specialist name the acquirer veto: write into the shareholders' agreement that their named technical domain cannot be sold, licensed or shut down without their signature while employed."}
33	 ]}

1	{"lens": "First principles", "pool": 2,
2	 "items": [
3	  {"id": "p2-001", "text": "Treat the twelve-month ramp as a variable rather than a constant: fund a standing team whose only measured output is cutting time-to-first-independent-shipment to six weeks."},
4	  {"id": "p2-002", "text": "Recruit only from people already ramped at their own expense — your customers, your contractors, and outside developers who have shipped against your API."},
5	  {"id": "p2-003", "text": "Pay the ramp cost as a cash loan at signing, forgiven one thirty-sixth per month and repayable on departure, with the outstanding balance shown on every payslip."},
6	  {"id": "p2-004", "text": "Back-load the wage curve: 70 percent of market for months zero to twelve, 140 percent from month eighteen, with the accrued gap stated as a running number."},
7	  {"id": "p2-005", "text": "Index every salary to a published external compensation benchmark and recompute it monthly by formula, so no human ever makes a repricing decision."},
8	  {"id": "p2-006", "text": "Assign each senior person a named percentage of the gross margin of the specific product line they own, paid quarterly, ending the day they leave."},
9	  {"id": "p2-007", "text": "Sell secondments instead of losing people: lease the person to the large employer for six paid months under a contract that returns them."},
10	  {"id": "p2-008", "text": "Replace open-ended employment with a two-year fixed term carrying a completion payment of six months' salary, forfeited entirely on early exit."},
11	  {"id": "p2-009", "text": "Stop employing; buy three days a week from people who keep their own company and other clients, so changing employer is never a reason to leave you."},
12	  {"id": "p2-010", "text": "Become the issuer of the credential: run a public, externally examined certification in your domain that can only be earned by doing your work."},
13	  {"id": "p2-011", "text": "Give the person legal ownership of the tool they build and take back an exclusive licence that lapses when their employment does."},
14	  {"id": "p2-012", "text": "Acquire one asset a large employer cannot obtain — a licensed facility, a sole-source dataset, a physical instrument — and route the role's daily work through it."},
15	  {"id": "p2-013", "text": "Contract with the household rather than the individual: guarantee a spouse's employment placement, childcare, or relocation package that terminates with the employment."},
16	  {"id": "p2-014", "text": "Sell shares for real money at a discount, requiring the person to write an actual cheque, so leaving means liquidating something they bought."},
17	  {"id": "p2-015", "text": "Accept eighteen-month tenure as a design constant: spend a fixed fifth of engineering capacity turning every project into a written artifact any contractor can resume in a week."},
18	  {"id": "p2-016", "text": "Pay a departing person a bounty equal to the full ramp cost for sourcing and fully training their own replacement before they go."},
19	  {"id": "p2-017", "text": "Hire every role in pairs from the start, so no single departure removes accumulated effectiveness and the second person carries the context forward."},
20	  {"id": "p2-018", "text": "Put the individual's name on the customer contract as the delivery principal, so the client relationship is personal, legally lodged here, and non-portable."},
21	  {"id": "p2-019", "text": "Halve the roadmap, halve the headcount, and pay the survivors 1.5x market from a budget that was already being spent."},
22	  {"id": "p2-020", "text": "Sign a formal feeder agreement with the large employers who poach: they pay an agreed placement fee per hire, and you plan the pipeline around it."},
23	  {"id": "p2-021", "text": "Convert the ownership structure so working staff hold the controlling block and vote on direction, and make the vote extinguish on the day someone leaves."},
24	  {"id": "p2-022", "text": "Establish a deferred trust that pays out over years after a four-year cliff, funded annually per head, forfeited in full before the cliff."},
25	  {"id": "p2-023", "text": "Buy the years outright: pay a transfer-fee-style lump sum today for a legally enforceable four-year exclusive commitment, priced against replacement cost."},
26	  {"id": "p2-024", "text": "Hand over legal signing authority and a bank mandate on day one, so the scarce good on offer is elapsed time rather than scope."},
27	  {"id": "p2-025", "text": "Operate as the person's agent for inbound offers: they route every unsolicited approach to you, you negotiate, and you take a stated percentage of any move you place them into."},
28	  {"id": "p2-026", "text": "Do the work under a licence or accreditation only your firm holds, so the accumulated skill is legally exercisable in very few other places."},
29	  {"id": "p2-027", "text": "Invoice the training explicitly: a signed schedule listing the cost of each month of ramp, repayable pro rata for thirty-six months on exit."},
30	  {"id": "p2-028", "text": "Write the person's name into the shipped artifact as its published author, and keep publishing under that name only while they remain."},
31	  {"id": "p2-029", "text": "Sponsor visas and absorb the immigration legal work yourself, recruiting from labour markets where large local employers do not compete for the same person."},
32	  {"id": "p2-030", "text": "Replace annual salary with a per-outcome price list, paying a fixed sum per shipped deliverable, so earnings rise with capability without any review event."}
33	 ]}
